practiceName: #8 teacher progress surface (covers AC1, AC2, AC4, AC5 evidence on the live view)
title: The assigning teacher opens the dashboard and sees the provisional run result with reason, provenance, and a read-only preview
turnSequence: After the s0-smoke loop completes in the same browser session, sign in again as amira.north@example.test and pick the synthetic fractions membership.
Open /dashboard and wait for the All results table.
Read the run row for the learner from s0-smoke and open its detail.
Assert the provisional note is present, the stored reason renders verbatim with the decision purpose, and the provenance line shows the rule version and evidence hash.
Assert the read-only preview section for the assigned approved screen is present (AC4).
expected: The dashboard renders the run from the just-completed loop: provisional label, plain-language reason with purpose, rule version plus evidence hash, and the read-only preview of the approved screen. Refreshing the dashboard repeats the same fields (AC1's read-side; the storage immutability proof is the progress database suite).
observableFailure: The table is empty for the assigning teacher, the reason or provenance line is missing, a mastery-style diagnosis appears instead of the provisional framing, or the preview section is absent.
